column1: # klogesoren1858 - key of Kloge Søren's cipher (simple substitution, one letter per sign, word spaces kept)
# License: CC BY 4.0 (Brice Dudout, Europe chiffrée, with Claude Opus 5.5 agents), 11 Nov 2026.
# Section A = the key as measured (frozen/KEY.json, SHA-256 40bf4b2d3da613cf1db2f0537ce30086cfcf5bf2de48ad3c14b4b8aa9404aefb), validated once on the held-out images 030-031.
# Section B = refinements made AFTER the measurement (separation of the stroke-and-dot signs, full-resolution reading); not measured.
# Section C = the writer's own alphabet table on image 091 left (a to ø), which confirms section A; letters from its alphabetical order.
# Section D = ligatures and variants met in the second session; read by sense, not measured.

column5: the dot is often missed in small writing
in the measured key also read h, j, c by place of the dot (see B)
a trap: two signs, not h
the two dots often drift onto the next sign in this hand
a second form ϟ written above it, probably by a later user
opposed to the straight dotted stroke for s
table 091 left, line 3 (order of x y z æ ø assumed)
frequent ligature; sometimes ad/da/ed/de by sense
Exempel, Sextende, strax; in places f (fem, Fuld)
